messages:
Andrea (All-hands): Quick post-allhands note — consolidating the reliability Q&A and the follow-ups we promised. Dropping links, owners, and a super-short checklist. Please react and add to INC-2034.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2034 (2026-05-21) archived. Timeline + traces: https://internal.redwood/incident/INC-2034/timeline.

Maria (SRE): Root cause summary in the RCA: https://docs.redwood.com/rca/inc-2034-2026-05-21. TL;DR: allocator edge-case under heavy prefix churn caused delayed GC and eviction stalls -> increased request latency and transient 504s.

Jamal (Eng Runtime): I pushed a defensive patch (PR: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pulls/450) that adds a guarded alloc path and improved metrics for live eviction rate. Plan to canary tomorrow 06:00 UTC at 3% with 3h observation. Owner: Jamal.

Xiao (Observability): I'll add a Grafana mixed panel for eviction rate + per-prefix inflight to the allhands dashboard and a short alert rule. Draft alert expr: policy_router_eviction_stalled_total > 0 for 2m.

Priya (Customer Success): I'll assemble per-tenant impact and a short customer note. Prefer plain language: what happened, who was affected, what we did, next steps. Owner: Priya. ETA: Mon 11:00 UTC.

Ryan (CTO): Tone note: be transparent, own it, and include the timeline and mitigation steps. I'll sign off on the customer note once Priya posts draft.

Andrea (All-hands): Short checklist being added to INC-2034 (please confirm owners):
- Hotfix + staging canary (owner: Jamal) — target: tomorrow 06:00 UTC.
- Add eviction/runaway-allocation alert + runbook (owner: Xiao + Maria) — due Wed EOD.
- Customer-facing summary + tenant table (owner: Priya) — due Mon 11:00 UTC.
- Automate fallback reroute prototype (owner: Eng Platform) — spike due in 10 days.
- CI regression for allocation churn (owner: Eng Runtime) — ticketed for next sprint.
- One-page exec summary (owner: Andrea) — due Mon EOD.

Maria (SRE): Adding runbook snippet to ops: "If eviction_stalled > 0 for >2m: 1) reduce ingress to fallback 2) restart policy-router 3) notify eng-runtime". Will flesh out.

Jamal (Eng Runtime): Canary config note: seq_len cap = 1536, max_kv_items = 10 for canary runs. Will post exact deploy link after rollout.

Xiao (Observability): I'll also add an annotation to the dashboard for the incident window and wire the alert to pager duty with a low-severity initial page.

Priya (Customer Success): Tagging CSMs now. If anyone can confirm the tenant list (IDs), paste them here or DM me.

Andrea (All-hands): Please react with :white_check_mark: once you add your tasks to INC-2034 and tag with "post-allhands" so I can filter. Planning a quick 20m sync Thu 09:00 UTC to validate progress.

Jamal (Eng Runtime): ✅ Hotfix PR merged, running stress tests. Will post staging canary URL here after deploy.

Xiao (Observability): ✅ Dashboard panel added in draft, pushing alert rule to ops-repo.

Maria (SRE): ✅ Runbook added (first pass).

Priya (Customer Success): ✅ Drafting customer note, will ping Ryan for review when ready.

Ryan (CTO): ✅ Will review customer note. Thanks for the quick coordinated work.

incident-bot: INC-2034 owner list updated: Jamal, Maria, Xiao, Priya.

Andrea (All-hands): Closing the loop here — if anything changes before Thu sync, paste short update. Otherwise, see you at Thu 09:00 UTC. Thanks all for rapid turnaround.
